source: fat cylinder, scale_mode=propagate. rings[].types is Term.Type in chain order. rings[].hangs is Term.remain (n_extra) from the same terms, not a default of 1 and not a type count. path_generate skips first_rows index 0, so first_rows_index = row + 1.

stuck.note: path_generate stopped on this first_rows row. chained_terms are the partial chain; remaining_terms were not linked. Neither set is in KnittingStitches.obj or rings[].

note: Exact Term.Type per finished face in OBJ generation order. hangs[] is Term.remain / n_extra from the same path_list points, not a default of 1. Do NOT infer Type from vertex colors. The stuck row is recorded under stuck, not as a finished ring.
